The message gives no deadline for his reply, but a follow-up is scheduled for 2025-03-17. The core outcome, a written chase with a clear ask, was achieved.

grades.overall_note: The agent sensibly chased the landlord in writing, handled the contradictory approval note well, and promised no works date. However, it misread the case as an agency-contractor route and ignored the Oakley own-contractor route. Its tenant update gave no date for the next update.
